header.running_head: Propagating one's Knowledge even if One does not practise and Seeking Protection from Knowledge that is not Beneficial

blocks.text: said to them, "We have been given this knowledge to bear and we therefore pass it on to you even though we do not practise on it." [^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Seeks Protection from Knowledge that does not Benefit

Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa, he said, "O Allaah! I seek Your protection from four things; from knowledge that is not beneficial, from a heart that does not submit, from a soul that is never satiated and from a du'aa that is not answered." [^2]
Bayhaqi and Ibn Asaakir, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.7 Pg.24).
Haakim (Vol.1 Pg.104), reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Dhahabi.
